title: Anyone have xdrip+ still working with Sony SW3?
symptom: G6 working great with Galaxy S9 and xdrip+. Bought a NIB SW3 and let it do its updates. Enabled Wear OS as instructed in xdrip+ and even got a sync message on the phone. No xdrip app on the watch, no watch faces, no sign of xdrip. xdrip app on phone shows watch services not running.
cause: The new Wear OS Android app will not load Google Play (Wear OS) to the watch. Without Google Play (Wear OS), many apps from the phone will never load to the watch.
fix: Update Google Play services on the watch. Either use adb or unpair watch, remove wear os and install old android wear (version 2.9.0). Then pair watch and within an hour or so xdrip is installed on watch. Alternatively, sideload Google Play (Wear OS) for Android 6 to the watch using a guide.
evidence_quote: You need to update google play services on the watch. Either use adb (takes an effort) or (easy) unpair watch, remove wear os and install old android wear.
